notes: Keyed by POLICY FORM, not marketed name: the 積立利率 hub (gu_int_rate.html) publishes one rate section per policy form. Marketed names are mapped to forms from the insurer's own product pages (see the distributors note).

Rates come from the shared hub page and the form's 基準金利 page. Collected by scripts/nwl.py (Wayback captures via_wayback=true, hand-saved live copy of 2026-11-17 via_wayback=false). nw-life.co.jp returns HTTP 403 to automated requests, so the collector never contacts it. Each capture shows only the then-current half-month 適用期間; effective_date is its first day. Gaps between captures are not interpolated.
Plans combine the two published cases (基本終身保険金額が生存給付金額の2倍以上 = r2ge / 2倍未満 = r2lt) with 生存給付金支払期間 (paylt20 = 20年未満, payge20 = 20年以上); age_band is 契約時の被保険者年齢.

Plan key encoding: term_years is 据置期間 where the table has one; age_band is 契約時の被保険者年齢 as printed (the live table, whatever its bands at the time); plan holds the other table dimensions (see plan_ja). Cells printed '-' are status not_offered.
has_mva is true because the form's 基準金利 page states that the 基準金利 is used for the 積立利率 and for the 市場価格調整率 on surrender; the MVA formula and loads are not collected.

Premium type: single premium is assumed from the task scope and from the しおり index, which groups only the 予定利率金利連動型外貨建個人年金保険 and 利率固定 外貨建個人年金保険 under 平準払; the product pages were not read to confirm the premium type of this form.

Product type whole_life_periodic_payout (was whole_life_unclassified until 2026-11-17): the policy name 積立利率金利連動型生存給付金付終身保険 is a whole life policy that pays a survival benefit (生存給付金) over a 生存給付金支払期間, which is how the rate table is split; Dai-ichi Frontier's 生存給付金付終身保険 (Premier Story 5) is typed the same way. The product page and brochure were not read.

Documents (2026-11-17): www.nw-life.co.jp answered HTTP 403 to one plain request (/shiori/g41/); not worked around. The Wayback Machine holds a capture of the しおり index page /shiori/g27/ (latest 2025-07-26, CDX 2026-11-17), but the archive answered HTTP 429 to every replay request from this network on 2026-11-17, so the PDF links it lists were not read; not worked around. The owner can save the PDFs from https://www.nw-life.co.jp/shiori/g27/ on a connection in Japan.

Launch date: 2017-02-01, from the news release (then MassMutual Life) on 生存給付金付終身保険『未来のバトン』 (Daiwa Securities), 正式名称 積立利率金利連動型生存給付金付終身保険（指定通貨建）. Sold later under other marketed names (e.g. 2017-06-05 プレシャスギフト, 2018-04-02 Nomura). Retrieved 2026-11-17.

Distributors and marketed names: mapped from nw-life.co.jp/product/individual/ product pages saved 2026-11-17 (sources/nwl/pages/product_*_2026-11-17.html), each of which states the 正式名称 of the policy forms it is sold under and lists its 募集代理店. A marketed product is attached to this form when its page names the form; one entry per bank and marketed name (product_name_ja). Pages naming several forms do not say which form a given contract uses (that follows the plan chosen, e.g. 告知/無告知コース, 介護保障), so an entry shows where the marketed name is sold, not that every plan there is this form. Marketed names mapped: 賢者のギフト、未来のバトン、プレシャスギフト、ニッセイ・ウェルス生存給付金付終身保険＜円建／外貨建＞. No distributor is listed for: 賢者のギフト (page says 現在お取扱い中の金融機関はありません).

Documents: PDFs downloaded 2026-11-17 from nw-life.co.jp (reachable from a Japan connection): all policy-conditions editions listed on the form's しおり page, and the brochures (契約締結前交付書面兼パンフレット) of the marketed products that the insurer's product pages tie to this form (not every marketed name for forms sold under many names). The shiori_web entry is the HTML index page, not a PDF.
notes_en: The insurer publishes rates by policy form rather than by marketed name, and the names sold to customers are not yet matched to forms.
The insurer's site blocks automated access, so rates come from archived copies and one saved copy of the current page; gaps between copies are not filled.
Rate history starts on 1 July 2020, with a small number of dates held, split by benefit size and payout period.
The premium type is assumed to be single premium; the product page was not read.
Classed as whole life with periodic payout from its policy name, which pays a survival benefit over a set period; the brochure has not been read.

No document could be downloaded: the insurer's site refuses connections from outside Japan and no archived copy of the policy conditions could be retrieved, so the policy-guide link opens only from a connection in Japan; the brochure and contract summary are not linked from the pages on file.
Launch date not established; the earliest archived copy is the earliest rate on file.

verification.method: A reproducible random sample (scripts/recheck_candidates_b.py, seed recheck-sample:nwl-form-survival-benefit-whole-life; every metric/plan/currency group, at least 10% per metric/plan, at least 20 rows) plus every outlier (a value outside 0-15%, more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, or more than 1pp from the previous point) was compared with its saved snapshot by an independent parser; all checked rows matched. A pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
